troyescathedral.name: Troyes Cathedral
troyescathedral.slogan: Sixteen hundred square metres of glass, lit from within.
troyescathedral.line: Rebuilt after a fire in 1188, it holds some 1,600 square metres of medieval and Renaissance stained glass.

vezelaybasilica.name: Vézelay Basilica
vezelaybasilica.slogan: A hilltop church where pilgrims set out for Santiago.
vezelaybasilica.line: At Easter 1146, Bernard of Clairvaux preached the Second Crusade here before King Louis VII.

guedelon.name: Guédelon Castle
guedelon.slogan: A thirteenth-century fortress, built stone by stone, today.
guedelon.line: Since 1997 builders have raised this castle using only 13th-century tools, materials and methods.

troyesruelledeschats.name: Ruelle des Chats
troyesruelledeschats.slogan: An alley so narrow the rooftops almost kiss.
troyesruelledeschats.line: Its name is said to come from cats leaping between the roofs on either side of the lane.

essoyesrenoir.name: Renoir's Essoyes
essoyesrenoir.slogan: The village where Renoir painted his wife's family and friends.
essoyesrenoir.line: Renoir built a studio in 1905 in the garden of the family home in Essoyes, and lies buried in the village cemetery.
